==Appearance==
A minor issue, but I noticed an inconsistency. It seems that there's currently a discrepancy between Perrin's height given in the description (1 span 2 inches) and his description that mentions he's tall, only half a head shorter than Rand. Rand's height on his page has now been altered to be 1 span 1 foot 7 inches; previously it was listed as 1 span 7 inches but that created an inconsistency with the height on Mat's page (1 span 1 foot 2 inches) since Rand is most definitely taller. I believe that Perrin is also taller than Mat. I have no sources on hand but based on commentary elsewhere and my own impressions, the trio's heights are probably closer to the following: Rand = 1 span 1 foot 7 inches, Perrin = 1 span 1 foot 4 inches, Mat = 1 span 1 foot 1 inch. RJ did say that Rand is supposed to be around six and a half feet tall. This is a little iffy because WoT inches aren't the same as US inches. 78 US inches is probably closer to 66 WoT inches, but that's more speculation. [[Special:Contributions/98.237.248.136|98.237.248.136]] 19:17, December 5, 2011 (UTC)El Pedanto
